languageSelection.title: Welcome
languageSelection.subtitle: Select your preferred language to begin your consultation
languageSelection.infoBody: After selecting your language, you'll be guided through a series of health-related questions. Your responses will help us provide better insights.
demographics.title: Step 1 — Demographics
demographics.subtitle: Please provide your basic demographic information
lifestyle.title: Lifestyle
lifestyle.subtitle: Tell us about your daily habits and routines
lifestyle.info: Lifestyle factors like sleep, exercise, and diet significantly impact your overall health and help us provide better assessments.
lifestyle.footer: Your health information is encrypted and securely stored
symptoms.title: Symptoms & Concerns
symptoms.subtitle: Describe any current symptoms or health concerns you're experiencing
symptoms.placeholder:
Be specific about:
• What symptoms you're experiencing
• When they started
• How often they occur
• Severity (mild/moderate/severe)
• What triggers or relieves them
• Any related activities or conditions
symptoms.exampleText: "Recurring headaches for 2 weeks, mostly in afternoon, moderate severity. Triggered by stress and long screen time. Pain is located in temples and forehead. Relieved by rest and paracetamol. No associated fever or nausea."
symptoms.tips: Be as specific as possible about location and timing
Include severity and impact on daily activities
Mention any known triggers or relief measures
symptoms.emergencyText: If you experience severe chest pain, difficulty breathing, loss of consciousness, or other life-threatening symptoms, please contact emergency services or visit the nearest hospital immediately.
symptoms.footer: Your symptom information is completely confidential and encrypted
mental.title: Mental Health & Wellness
mental.subtitle: Share information about your mental health, stress levels, and emotional well-being
mental.label: Mental Health & Stress
mental.placeholder:
Share information about:
• Current stress levels (low/moderate/high)
• Anxiety or worry patterns
• Mood changes or concerns
• Sleep quality and patterns
• Emotional challenges
• Work-life balance
• Coping strategies you use
• Any history of mental health conditions
• Current support systems
mental.exampleTitle: Example of comprehensive mental health information:
mental.exampleText: "Experiencing moderate work-related stress with occasional anxiety. Sleep quality is affected, typically 6-7 hours per night. I cope by exercising 3x/week and meditation on weekdays. Have supportive family and friends. Mood generally stable but sometimes feel overwhelmed. No previous mental health diagnosis. Looking to improve work-life balance."
mental.tipsTitle: Tips for sharing mental health information:
mental.tips: Be honest about your stress levels and emotional state
Include both challenges and positive coping mechanisms
Mention any significant life events or changes
Share what helps you feel better and what worsens stress
Include any history of anxiety, depression, or other conditions
mental.privacyText: All mental health information is completely confidential and protected. This information is used only to provide appropriate medical care and support.
mental.footer: Mental health information is crucial for comprehensive care and is always confidential

confirmation.title: Consultation Complete!
confirmation.subtitle: Thank you for completing your health consultation
confirmation.privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection
confirmation.privacy.deidentifiedText: Your consultation data has been automatically deidentified. All personal identifiers have been removed and will not be stored with your medical information.
confirmation.privacy.researchText: Your deidentified data will be securely archived and used solely for improving AI diagnostic and exam recommendation systems. No clinical decisions will be made based on this data.
confirmation.privacy.storageText: Your data is encrypted and stored in secure, HIPAA-compliant facilities. Access is restricted to authorized research personnel only.
confirmation.privacy.deidentified: Your data has been deidentified and will be securely archived.
confirmation.privacy.identifiersRemoved: All personal identifiers have been removed.
confirmation.privacy.researchUse: This data will be used solely for research purposes.
confirmation.next.title: What Happens Next?
confirmation.next.step1Text: Your AI-generated diagnoses and recommended exams will be reviewed by a qualified healthcare professional.
confirmation.next.step2Text: You will receive feedback from the healthcare professional regarding the AI recommendations and suggested next steps.
confirmation.next.step3Text: Your ratings and evaluations help train better AI diagnostic systems that will benefit future patients.
confirmation.thanksTitle: Thank You for Contributing to Research
confirmation.thanksText: Your participation in this AI-driven consultation system helps us improve healthcare diagnostics and benefit future patients worldwide.
